description: This file defines a Java interface named ModifyCommandResponseAdapter that extends the generic Adapter interface, providing default behaviors related to modify command responses in a protocol adapter context. It specifies criteria, actions, and response targeting for such adapters.

classes.name: ModifyCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: A Java interface for adapting modify command responses within a protocol adapter, providing default implementations for selection criteria and actions related to command response topics.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the criteria set indicating the types of topics this adapter is concerned with, specifically command-related topics.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns the set of actions (CREATE, MODIFY, DELETE) that this adapter handles for command responses.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is intended for responses, returning true.
